title: Why Child Mortality Keeps Falling So Fast
hook: Your kid's odds of dying before age five just fell sharply. Here's what changed.
closing: Progress doesn't announce itself. It just quietly happens.
question: Did you get your shots as a kid?

segments.say: Child mortality under age five has fallen to just 37.4 per thousand live births worldwide.
The basic childhood immunization shot now reaches 85 percent of kids worldwide, nearly everywhere.
Global health spending has climbed to 10.1 percent of world GDP, funding that progress.
